Chat request with tool_choice specifying a particular function to call

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather in Paris?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tool_choice\":{\"function\":{\"name\":\"get_weather\"},\"type\":\"function\"},\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city name\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"},{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Search the web for information\",\"name\":\"search_web\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"query\":{\"description\":\"The search query\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"query\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val apiKey = requireNotNull(System.getenv("API_KEY")) { "API_KEY must be set" }
    val result = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey = apiKey).use { client -> client.chat(req) }
    println(result.choices)
    println(result.choices.first().message.toolCalls)
    println(result.choices.first().message.toolCalls?.first()?.function?.name)
    println(result.choices.first().finishReason)
}
```
